stories.title: Chester’s Grosvenor Park street food event launches this Saturday
stories.summary: A free two-day street food event at Grosvenor Park in Chester on Saturday and Sunday, 27 and 28 June, launches the 2026 Storyhouse in the Park season. stories.title: Flintshire fundraiser in his 80s shortlisted for BBC Wales award for annual Connah’s Quay to Chester row
stories.summary: A Flintshire man in his 80s who rows from Connah’s Quay to Chester every year to raise money for Cancer Research UK has been shortlisted for a BBC Wales award. stories.title: Ombudsman finds BCUHB failings after patient given morphine in error and died two days later
stories.summary: The Public Services Ombudsman for Wales has issued a public interest report finding that Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board issued a patient with morphine sulphate in error on discharge from Wrexham Maelor Hospital, and that he died of a morphine overdose two days later. stories.title: UK government unveils plans to speed up home sales and stop deals falling through
stories.summary: Home buyers in England and Wales could see purchase times cut by around four weeks and first-time buyers save an average of £650 under government reforms to the home buying process announced on Friday. stories.title: Customer toilets coming to Eastgate Square Chester after shoppers called for facilities
stories.summary: Customer toilets are returning to Eastgate Square in Chester, with work under way to install facilities on the first floor of the unit that previously housed Topshop.
